name: acsp-confirm-client-id-verification-web
description: A web application to tell Companies House you have verified someone’s identity.

scripts.build:server: tsc && cp -r src/views dist/views && cp -r config dist/
scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build:server
scripts.start: npm run build && source ./dist/config/.env && node dist/server.js
scripts.sonarqube: branch=$(git rev-parse --symbolic-full-name --abbrev-ref HEAD); if [[ $branch == "HEAD" ]]; then echo $branch && npm run sonarqube-base-branch; else echo $branch && npm run sonarqube-pull-request; fi;

@package sass: We're using an older version of @sass to suppress deprecation warnings thrown by the @govuk-frontend package during the build
We'll upgrade to the most recent version of @sass after this issue is fixed in the @govuk-frontend package
@package nodemon: chokidar is overridden to 4.x for nodemon because chokidar 3.x depends on braces, which has an unpatched high severity vulnerability (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm)

nodemon always passes interval: pollingInterval to chokidar; when unset this is undefined, which overrides chokidar 4's default (chokidar 3 restored it), so pollingInterval must be set in nodemon.json and nodemonConfig for --legacy-watch (used by chs-dev) to work
Remove the chokidar override and pollingInterval once nodemon depends on a chokidar version without braces

@package @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config: js-yaml is overridden to v4 to remove js-yaml@3 -> argparse@1 -> sprintf-js (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, no patched sprintf-js release)
load-nyc-config only calls yaml.load(), which is compatible with js-yaml v4

nodemonConfig.exec: npm run build && source ./dist/config/.env && node dist/server.js
